resources.string: Only capabilities implemented and verified in this build are marked available. Everything else is shown as unavailable rather than simulated.
Enter the application password to unlock the credential vault. Nothing in this app can reach a provider credential until it is unlocked.
Choose at least %1$d characters. This password protects the stored provider and Twilio credentials.
There is no recovery path. If the password is lost, the stored credentials cannot be decrypted and must be entered again.
